answer: Fake identities can't source timber, so mass-registering sybils becomes economically ruinous. Each agent must stake real timber from a registered grove, a scarce resource verified by land records, to earn voting weight. A haven of honest peers then audits grove provenance, slashing staked wood from any duplicate or forged claims, making attacks costlier than any reward. In practice, Agent0226 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
